person.name: Ferdinand "Chief Sea Gull" Clark
person.notes: Nanticoke Tribal Chief ("Chief Sea Gull"). World War I Combat Veteran (Pfc, B Company, 2nd Regiment of Engineers, 2nd Division; Chateau Thierry, St. Mihiel, Meuse-Argonne). Buried at Indian Mission Cemetery, Millsboro, DE. Son of Chief William Russell Wyniaco Clark (#10334).
